messages:
Ivy Chen: Hi all, small onboarding snag. I used the company email ivy.chen@redwood.com on the paperwork but the Okta invite link keeps saying 'no account found' after I click it. My Google Workspace account isn't active yet either. Also when I tried to request a 1Password seat it says my email is already assigned to someone else. Can someone point me to the shortest path to get temporary Drive/docs access?

Marta (People Ops): Hey Ivy  welcome! Sorry about that. Can you confirm the email you used on the offer letter and the preferred personal backup email? I'll check provisioning and seat assignment.

Ivy Chen: Offer letter has ivy.chen@redwood.com. I put ivy.chen.personal@gmail.com as backup. I haven't received any Okta or Google activation emails.

Liam (IT): Hi Ivy  common double-hit: workspace account provisioning sometimes lags and 1Password seats can remain attached to a placeholder account from a contractor. Two quick things: 1) Marta, can you confirm AD/Cloud Identity user exists? 2) Ivy, can you share the last 6 of the hire ID so we can correlate? Meanwhile I can grant a temporary shared link to the onboarding folder and create a throwaway Google alias (ivy.chen.temp@redwood.com) for immediate access.

Marta (People Ops): Pulling the user now. Hire ID ends 7342. Looks like the identity record was created but the email alias wasn't activated due to a sync error. Also seeing a 1Password seat tied to ivy.chen@redwood.com but owner field is empty (likely a stale mapping). I'll mark it for reassignment.

Liam (IT): Ok I'll reprovision the alias and force a directory sync. Steps I'm running now:
```
- gcloud identity users create --email=ivy.chen.temp@redwood.com --display-name="Ivy Chen temp"
- trigger sync: /scripts/dir-sync --force --user=ivy.chen@redwood.com
```
I'll also add a provisional Drive share (view) to ivy.chen.personal@gmail.com for onboarding until the account is live.

Onboarding Bot: Ticket #99123 created: IT:provisioning assigned to Liam. ETA ~90 minutes.

Marta (People Ops): Reassigned 1Password seat from stale mapping to Ivy (ticket #99126). Ivy, you should get an email to accept shortly. Rae, can you confirm manager sign-off so we can approve key access?

Rae (Manager): Confirmed. Please give Ivy view access to team docs. Welcome aboard Ivy! :tada:

Ivy Chen: I received a provisional Drive link to my personal email and the 1Password invite popped in. Thank you. Quick Q: once the real workspace account is up, will my crypto YubiKey enrollment carry over or will I need to re-register?

Liam (IT): Good question. For hardware keys we recommend re-enrolling under the canonical workspace account to ensure the credential is tied to that identity. Passkeys may carry over if you export them first, but hardware tokens typically need a re-touch. We'll help with enrollment once directory sync completes.

Ivy Chen: Makes sense. Thanks for the quick triage everyone.
